steps.input:
import numpy as np, collections, textwrap
program='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(range(10), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in g for v in row))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # A complete, one-color rectangular frame.
            border = all(g[y][x] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in (c0,c1)) and all(g[y][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1) for y in (r0,r1))
            if not border:
                continue
            if any(g[y][x] != bg for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)):
                continue
            area = (r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)
            fill = 7 if area % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    g[y][x] = fill
    return g
'''
p=base/'programs'/'task-5c3404ad.py'
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print('saved',p)
